paragraphs.text: South Pontotoc’s boys will wrestle twice Thursday night at Oxford High School, with the girls’ dual against the host Chargers between the two boys’ matches. Wrestling starts at 6 p.m. in the high school gym at 101 Charger Loop in Oxford.

Oxford and French Camp open the meet with a boys’ dual. French Camp stays on the mat to face South Pontotoc in the second dual. Fans coming primarily for the Cougars should use the 6 p.m. opening as their guide. The host lists the order of matches without assigning a separate start time to South’s first appearance.

The South Pontotoc and Oxford girls meet third, followed by the boys from the same two schools in the last dual. It is the first home date on Oxford’s boys’ and girls’ wrestling schedule, following its Nov. 14 trip to Memphis for the Tiger Tussle.
